_comment: Per-language clause text that may precede an organization name before a legal-form suffix. `phrases` are trimmed unconditionally when found inside an over-captured legal-form span. `directPrefixes` are trimmed only when the text before the prefix already looks like prose, so company names such as `Stand By Me LLC` are preserved. `partyLabelArticles` are permitted only before a scoped party role in a labelled subject clause.
